title: A fixed whole changes role with argument position, not meaning
summary: Test whether one complete recurring form is a process action carrier in one licensed slot but a material/property carrier in another, versus a single portable translation.

design.mechanism: The compiler assigns role by argument position and neighboring field types while preserving the whole's local identity.
design.unit: exact whole occurrences with two independently typed neighboring fields
design.contrast: same whole in action-slot versus material/property-slot contexts, matched by owner and register
design.prediction: Successor and predecessor type constraints separate the two roles reproducibly, while a portable translation model predicts the same neighbor-type profile.
design.falsifier: No role-by-slot interaction on held occurrences, or it vanishes after whole identity and register controls.
design.scope: cached source cases with existing field-role annotations; feasibility_unknown for enough cross-slot repeats
design.related: GDT633/GDT685 and GDT765 discuss role/context contrasts; this proposal tests a fixed whole's slot interaction without adding a decoder
